& I'm suggesting there are

ae) SCULLY'S POV - THROUGH THE WINDOWPANE
Past the parked cop cars, we see an N.D. SEDAN idling on the far
side of the street. Inside it sit the two DARK-SUITED MEN we
recognize as Mr. Sim's mysterious visitors from the night before.
They peer out at us, inscrutable -- keeping tabs on the place.
They know they've been spotted... the driver turns forward and
puts the car into gear. All of this is done calmly, casually.

26 INT. BILL JR.'S HOUSE - DINING AREA - LATE NIGHT 26
All is dark and quiet -- just moon and streetlight coming in
through the windows. Offscreen, we hear the front door unlock
& and open, then gently shut.
A dark figure eases through the living room into the kitchen,
trying not to make noise. It reaches for the switch, and
CLICK -- we see it's Scully, holding a manila envelope.
She spies another, bigger envelope that lies on the otherwise-
empty dining room table. We see it's addressed to her from the
FBI's San Diego field office. She tears it open.
Inside the envelope is a thick packet of materials: FBI
casefile, medical records, etc. What Scully immediately goes
for, however, is a clear plastic sheet with gray smudges on Eis
It's a PCR print, identified as belonging to MELISSA SCULLY.
